answer.worked:
The recorded outcome is the larger number, rather than the ordered pair. The possible larger numbers are $5,6,7,8,9$.

$$\xi=\{5,6,7,8,9\}.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the probability of each outcome.

answer.short:
$P(5)=\frac{1}{10},\quad P(6)=\frac{1}{10},\quad P(7)=\frac14,\quad P(8)=\frac{7}{20},\quad P(9)=\frac15$.
